symptom: Distinct Local roots with the same basename share a fallback repo slug. A local-link read can replace that slug's warm cache with rows for only its destination root, causing File > Open Folder to treat another root's absent row as proof that no workspace exists. Cloud catalog siblings also share a repository slug while each row has its own cloud:// workspace root.
rule: For Local roots, a matching canonical live row may suppress first-workspace creation; otherwise force an authoritative reload and fail closed if it cannot be confirmed. Scope Local landing and restoration by canonical root, but keep cloud workspace siblings grouped by the caller-scoped repository and owner instead of treating their distinct cloud:// keys as separate repositories.
